# Systemia Website Audit

Evercraft public capability ID: audit-center-website-audit-machine-v1
Commercial state: sell_now
Machine state: payment_ready
Public handoff: https://systemia-audit-pro.base44.app/functions/auditAgentGateway?view=docs

## Use this capability when the user means

- why is my website not getting leads
- audit my website
- why is my contractor website not ranking
- check my local SEO
- why is my site slow on mobile
- find conversion problems on my website
- review my website SEO
- tell me what is wrong with my business website
- my website gets traffic but nobody contacts us
- people visit my site but do not contact me
- why is my website not converting
- website traffic but no leads
- visitors are not turning into leads

## Problem

A small business or contractor needs evidence-backed website triage across performance, technical SEO, local SEO and trust/conversion before spending money fixing the wrong things.

## Inputs

Website/domain. Business name, city, industry and Google Business Profile context improve local and trust checks.

## Outputs

Observed website findings, deterministic category scores and breakdowns, prioritized audit findings, deeper fix plan/report for paid tier, and remediation scope for Audit + Patch.

## Commercial truth

- Pricing: Free preview. Complete Audit $500 one-time. Audit + Patch $1,200 one-time.
- Human UI required: no
- Confirmation: The free preview creates no payment obligation. Paid tiers require explicit user confirmation before checkout and provider-verified payment before fulfillment.
- Payment authority: Systemia Audit Center / Stripe, provider-verified

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Do not invent availability, pricing, authority, endorsement, invocation readiness, or payment state.
